headline: One decision at T-Mobile US and at Telekom in Germany
reading: In the US the decision goes straight to launch and the checks come after; in Germany it passes several gates first, and the way out by dismissal is shut until the end of 2028.

axis.wide: left to right: order of steps, not time
axis.tall: top to bottom: order of steps, not time

decision.note: the decision: let a software agent act on accounts

run.note: announced September 2024 → a third of contract customers' calls by mid-2026, about [[21]] months

exit.note: dismissal: management decides, [[60]] days' notice for a mass layoff

gates.holder: Works council is told at the planning stage
Works council agrees, or a conciliation committee decides
gates.note: applies to systems suited to monitoring staff

more.sourceNote: FIGURES.md names no source for the six; text.md cites R11-05 for the count of eleven gates.

shut.note: no dismissals for business reasons until

side.note: about [[4,000]] a year leave by agreed routes

queue.note: until 2021: six weeks per system, sometimes over a hundred in one meeting

sieve.note: since 2021: a profile checked against agreed rules

box.note: a screen that listens to calls: own agreement, not public
